claims.claim: A 19-year-old woman was killed after an e-scooter collided head-on with the side of a westbound transit bus while travelling northbound on Seymour Street in Vancouver.
claims.source_title: 19-year-old woman killed in collision between e-scooter and transit bus in Vancouver
claims.supporting_quote: Police say a man and woman were riding an e-scooter northbound on Seymour Street when they collided head on with the side of a westbound transit bus.

claims.claim: Neither the woman nor the man riding with her on the e-scooter was wearing a helmet.
claims.episode_span: neither the victim nor the man riding with her on the scooter was wearing a helmet
claims.source_title: Woman hit by bus, killed while riding e-scooter in Vancouver
claims.supporting_quote: Neither the victim, nor the man riding with her on the scooter, were wearing helmets.

claims.episode_span: authorities are warning about high winds bringing more power outages

claims.supporting_quote: As storms continue across B.C., authorities are warning about high winds bringing more power outages and the dangers of rising water levels.

claims.claim: Wind gusts up to 100 km/h hit Prince George and the region Friday night, downing trees onto homes.
claims.episode_span: wind gusts up to 100 km/h in Prince George and the region on Friday night
claims.source_title: Heavy wind downs trees, closing roads and knocking out power in Prince George, B.C., and region
claims.supporting_quote: Following wind gusts up to 100 km/h Friday night social media was flooded with photos of the ensuing damage, which included trees on homes and, in one instance, a traffic light gone from its location.

claims.claim: The Whitecaps offered Belal Halbouni, 26, diagnosed with Hodgkin lymphoma, a contract through the end of the 2027-28 season.
claims.episode_span: It runs through the end of the 2027-28 season.
claims.source_title: Whitecaps standing strong for Belal Halbouni in his cancer fight
claims.supporting_quote: But the Whitecaps didn’t want Halbouni to feel stress about his playing situation and offered him a contract that doesn’t just go through the end of the 2027 sprint season next June, but through the end of the 2027-28 season.

claims.claim: A Vancouver home valued at $1.7 million sold for half that price at a City of Vancouver tax sale of more than 60 properties.
claims.episode_span: a Vancouver home valued at $1.7 million sold for half that price
claims.source_title: $1.7M Vancouver home sells for half the price at tax auction
claims.supporting_quote: The home was among more than 60 properties auctioned off in this year's City of Vancouver tax sale, set off by owners who have not paid their taxes for three years in a row, with the reserve, or upset prices, set at the amounts owed to the city.

claims.claim: The mayors of Vancouver and Victoria back a federal plan that sets aside $11.2 billion over four years to end homelessness within 10 years.
claims.episode_span: set aside $11.2 billion over the next four years
claims.source_title: 'Absolutely' possible: Vancouver, Victoria mayors back Ottawa's bid to end homelessness
claims.supporting_quote: The federal Liberal budget, delivered on Thursday, has set aside $11.2 billion over the next four years in a bid to end homelessness in the next 10 years.
